error.heading: Couldn't load environments.
error.body: Check the connection and try again.

agent_offline.hint: Check that it's running. It reconnects by itself when it can reach Bayplan.

tls_untrusted.text: The agent doesn't trust Bayplan's certificate.
tls_untrusted.hint: Use a certificate from a public CA, or reinstall the agent with the command from Show install command.

auth_rejected.hint: Generate a new join token and reinstall the agent with the new command.

cert_expired.text: The agent's certificate expired before it could renew.
cert_expired.hint: Reinstall the agent with a fresh join token. It enrols again with a new certificate.

cert_expiring.hint: Check that the agent can reach Bayplan.

revoked.hint: Remove the agent from the host. To let it back in, unblock the node in Settings, then enrol it again.

blocked.text: A node is blocked from enrolling.
blocked.hint: Unblock it in Settings, in the nodes list.

version_incompatible.text: The agent can't talk to this Bayplan.

clock_skew.text: The clock on a node is out of step.
clock_skew.hint: Sync the host's clock. Bayplan accepts up to 5 minutes of difference.

timeout.hint: Check the network between the host and Bayplan. The agent reconnects by itself.

not_a_manager.hint: Only worker nodes are connected. Check the agent on a manager node.

no_quorum.hint: Bring a manager node back online. Node-local data still works.

cluster_changed.hint: Adopt the new cluster to keep this environment, or remove it.

engine_unreachable.hint: Check that /var/run/docker.sock is mounted into the agent and that Docker is running.

unsupported_engine.text: Docker on a node isn't supported.
unsupported_engine.hint: Bayplan needs Docker Engine 24 or later.

agent_policy_denied.hint: The host's agent policy doesn't allow it. This is recorded in the audit log.

unreachable.text: Docker isn't answering on the local socket.
unreachable.hint: Check that /var/run/docker.sock is mounted into Bayplan and that Docker is running.

api_too_old.text: This Docker Engine is older than Bayplan supports.
api_too_old.hint: Bayplan needs Docker Engine 24 or later.

rootless.hint: Bayplan manages Docker Engine 24 or later.

docker_desktop.hint: Bayplan manages Docker Engine 24 or later.

pending.hint: Install the Bayplan agent on a host to start managing it.

reconnecting.text: Bayplan just started and is waiting for the agent to reconnect.
reconnecting.hint: This usually takes under a minute.

degraded.text: Something is wrong on part of this environment.
degraded.hint: Open it to see which node.

revoked.hint: Remove the agents from the hosts, or unblock them in Settings.

cluster_changed.hint: Adopt the new cluster to keep this environment, or remove it.

unsupported.hint: Bayplan manages Docker Engine 24 or later.
